title: The Sleepwalking Children
text: Children of the lower town walk at night, eyes shut, in perfect step. They gather at the foot of the Rift Gate and sing a song none of them were taught.

options.label: Lock the children in at night.

outcomes.text: The doors are barred. The singing comes through the walls anyway, quieter.
Barred doors are no use. At dawn one bed is empty, and the song has one voice fewer.

options.label: Send a Scion to walk with them to the Gate.

outcomes.text: The Scion learns the song, and the song is a map of the dark beyond the Gate.
The Scion learns the song, and cannot stop humming it, even asleep.

options.label: Wake them all at once, with the bells.

outcomes.text: They wake screaming, and remember nothing. The song stops.
They wake, and something far off wakes with them. The Gate's light changes color.
